title: Social Growth Engine
targetUser: A small founder-led team operating several social accounts
trigger: The team has a campaign direction but not enough time to draft and schedule each channel
promise: A small team keeps each brand voice consistent while a measurable content loop compounds growth

behaviorChange.before: People manually write, publish, and review every account separately
behaviorChange.after: The team approves one direction, schedules a real item, and uses performance to improve the next draft

magicMoment.definition: After one approval, a channel-ready item is scheduled and its status is visible immediately

wedge.definition: Performance evidence changes the next draft instead of stopping at multi-account publishing

nonGoals.rule: Do not build a complex organization permission system in v0
Do not support every social network before the core loop is proven

journeys.observableOracle: A reviewable draft appears within 60 seconds

journeys.productResponse: Schedule the item for the selected account
journeys.observableOracle: A real scheduled item and its status are visible

journeys.userAction: Choose the account and confirm the draft
journeys.productResponse: Prepare the approved item for scheduling
journeys.observableOracle: The selected account and approved content are visible before scheduling
The scheduler acknowledges the item without duplication

journeys.productResponse: Explain how evidence changes the next draft
journeys.observableOracle: The next draft cites an observed performance signal
The scheduled status is visible immediately

code.description: Schedule retries do not duplicate an item

journey.description: A founder can trigger → approve → schedule → inspect status

thesis.description: A subsequent draft includes a performance-based change

goals.title: One-account draft to scheduled status vertical slice
goals.localObjective: Generate one channel-ready draft, accept one approval, schedule a real item, and show its status
localAcceptance: A draft can be generated for one account
One approval creates one scheduled item
The scheduled status is visible after the operation
globalAcceptance: The founder does not re-enter account configuration after choosing the campaign direction
The experience delivers the declared Magic Moment in one user-visible flow
forbiddenScope: Do not add organization roles or a generic workflow builder
goals.escalationRule: Return to the product decision owner if one approval cannot produce a visible schedule status

thesis: one approval reduces manual channel work

goals.title: Performance signal informs the next draft
goals.localObjective: Connect an observed performance signal to a concrete next-draft suggestion
localAcceptance: The suggestion cites one observed signal
globalAcceptance: The user can recognize why the next draft changed
forbiddenScope: Do not support every network before the core loop is proven
goals.escalationRule: Escalate if evidence cannot be linked to a draft change

productMovie.sharing: The team shares a clear status

controls.pause: Pause the compiler run before external publication
controls.cancel: Cancel the current run without publishing
